title: precheck names a python -c check whose guard line binds names after sys.exit, which fails on NameError once the work is in
goal: backlog.py precheck (and check) warns of a python3 -c check whose 'if ...:' guard line goes on after sys.exit(...) with statements that bind names a later line reads: on the base the guard exits first, so the check fails for its premise, but after the work those names are unbound and the check raises NameError (ST-eefdl6am's check 0 stopped its landing at step checks; ST-xqqcu4zz's had the same defect and was fixed before its claim)

run:
import subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','check'],capture_output=True,text=True)
sys.exit(0 if 'guard line' in (p.stdout+p.stderr) or 'after sys.exit' in open('_tools/bl_check.py',encoding='utf-8').read() else 1)
